checks.exercise: Bilateral seated ankle dorsiflexion, distinct from heel raises
checks.equipment: Stable four-leg seat, no added load
checks.setup: 움직이지 않는 의자에 앉아 무릎을 굽히고 양발을 바닥에 둔다.
checks.hands: Relaxed open hands held above thighs; no simulated support force
checks.feet: Fixed bilateral virtual heel pivots; toes rise together
checks.movement: 뒤꿈치를 고정한 채 양쪽 발끝과 앞꿈치를 들어 올렸다가 천천히 내린다.

limitations: Slow procedural demonstration with 25-degree ankle rotation.
Heel pivots are rig landmarks; rendered skin has 0.02–0.044 model-unit floor clearance.
Seat contact is approximate and sampled; no tissue compression or complete collision simulation.
